ctx.x: Yeah. Mezz, Mezz. So -- so, okay, we got smoking this joint. Now, when -- at intermission, when we're going to smoke, if we didn't have a dressing room, the police would stand in front of the bandstand so nobody could get to us while we -- while we got high. If we had a dressing room, we would all go in Louie's dressing room and then close the door and the police would put his chair right in front of the door and sit there so nobody could enter. And -- while we got high. Nobody never bothered us about getting high.
